text:
Jess: ok quick heads-up, new office tradition proposal: Milo Sock Pact. details below.
Omar: wait what's the pact? :eyes:
Milo: you know i have a sock drawer of shame. what's this involve?
Anya: the idea: for every town-hall Milo wears one proudly mismatched sock, you get a sticker. after 5 meetings you get a mug. :coffee:
Jess: and we document it forever on the fridge. maybe a leaderboard.
Milo: i'm in if someone mails me the stickers. but i draw the line at glitter socks.
Omar: i'll make a tiny leaderboard app — two fields: name, sock level. `PUT /pact/milo` -> level++ :laughing:
ops-bot: poll created: "Do you support the Milo Sock Pact?" Options: Yes/For Science/No. React with :thumbsup: to vote.
Jess: also vow: anyone who forgets socks buys donuts next week. rules are negotiable.
Milo: fine. donut clause seems ominous. :sweat_smile:
Anya: @Milo can we get a ceremonial sock-launch photo at the next all-hands? :camera:
Omar: agreed. i'll code the leaderboard tonight. PR incoming titled `the-sock-pact`.
Jess: legendary. adding to random lore archives. :trophy:
Milo: signing digitally: `milo — sock-pact 1.0`
Omar: now to pick mismatched socks. suggestions: pineapples + polka dots. :socks:
Anya: vote in thread pls.
